// 镜头 1：用呼吸霓虹和轻微色差建立城市招牌质感。
@ bg(color="#03040a")
@ cam.zoom(0.78, 1.2s)!
{NIGHT CITY} @ f.neonGlow(color="#00f5ff", shadow="#020714", strength=2.6, radius=11, width=2.5, pulse=0.28, speed=0.8).chromaticAberration(x=4, y=0.5, pulse=0.24, speed=1.2).big.big

// 镜头 2：安全边界开始失稳，短促震动配合逐字跳帧。
@ bg(color="#080311")

@ cam.move(-180, 0, 0.7s)!
{SECURITY PERIMETER} @ f.neonGlow(color="#ff375f", shadow="#160207", strength=2.4, radius=9, pulse=0.5, speed=2.4).digitalFlicker(rate=24, duty=0.28, intensity=0.72, minAlpha=0.25).big

// 镜头 3：完整的 AE 式 glitch burst，镜头快速推近。
@ bg(color="#020207")
@ cam.reset(0.25s)!
@ cam.zoom(1.24, 0.55s)!
[.neonGlow:block(color="#00f5ff", shadow="#04020b", strength=3.1, radius=13, width=3, pulse=0.32, speed=1.9) .cyberGlitch:block(rgb=24, frequency=10, burst=0.5, blockSize=18, noise=0.28, jitter=6) .chromaticAberration:block(x=12, y=1.5, pulse=0.55, speed=3.2)]
SIGNAL BREACH
